messages.content: 請問你能幫我取得兩起訴訟的詳細資料嗎？第一起訴訟的案件編號是「12345」，在「紐約最高法院」提出，我想知道這起案件的判決細節。第二起訴訟的案件編號是「67890」，在「洛杉磯高等法院」提出，我不需要這起案件的判決細節。

function.name: get_lawsuit_details
function.description: Retrieve details of a lawsuit based on its case number and court location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court_location.description: The location of the court where the lawsuit was filed.

with_verdict.description: Flag to include verdict details if available. Default is False
